title: Quantities
description: data/quantities.json (issue #9, calc/domains/quantities.py) -- the quantities of what the position plans draw: one row per element carrying a position (its plan, its position, its material, its section, its length in m, its area in m², its volume in m³, each null where it cannot be had), and the summary of the whole project and of each plan, by material then section with a total per material. Written by the export; show-plan-quantities and sheet-quantities print it and add up only the rows of the positions a call names. Lengths and areas from the plan's scale; a volume for timber alone (rec, cir on a line; pla, clt on a slab).
